dataset_prohibitions: drift_holdout is forbidden for replay, births, refinement, retirement, thresholds, topology, and model selection
original_task_retention_holdout is forbidden for replay, births, refinement, retirement, thresholds, topology, and model selection
planning cases are forbidden for replay, births, refinement, retirement, thresholds, topology, and model selection
final validation observations cannot repair this candidate, its seeds, regimes, or gates

common_gates.rationale: The bounded adaptation procedure must complete.
The base representation must establish the bounded task before drift.
Anchored base behavior may lose at most ten percentage points in absolute retained accuracy.
Every routed classification must agree with complete scan.
Canonical in-memory restoration must succeed.
Restored complete model identity must match.
Restored evaluation and planning behavior must match.
Every declared behavioral and byte-level checkpoint mutation must be detected.
Generation, lineage uniqueness, descendant splitting, and deterministic topology invariants must hold.
Unsupported actions cannot enter the planning graph.
The declared replay budget must be filled on the non-sparse trial corpus.
Balanced replay cannot introduce accidental duplicates.
Replay must retain every declared label.
Replay must retain every declared action.
Replay must cover at least 60 of 64 source states.
Replay must retain broad assigned-expert coverage.
Replay must preserve broad source-state/action transition support.
At least three quarters of bounded planning cases must have a supported path.
Adaptation cannot exceed the declared expert capacity.
Retirement remains optional and bounded.
Accepted adaptation-training topology decisions cannot reduce their declared objective.
Candidate training work may exceed the matched fixed-topology budget by at most ten percent.
Routed inference must use at most one quarter of flat complete-scan expert evaluations.

separated_state.rationale: The separated-state task remains high-accuracy after adaptation.
An already strong static model must not lose more than two points.
Separated observations support an exact-state capability gate.
The low-drift regime cannot consume the full topology budget.

partially_overlapping_observations.rationale: Overlap must retain high adapted classification.
Limited headroom uses non-inferiority rather than a fixed gain.
Partial overlap remains distinguishable enough for exact-state planning.
The low-drift regime cannot consume the full topology budget.

increased_observation_noise.rationale: Noisy observations must retain high adapted classification.
Limited headroom uses non-inferiority rather than a fixed gain.
Adaptation cannot worsen reconstruction under increased noise.
Adaptation cannot worsen prediction under increased noise.
Noise permits a lower but explicit exact-state planning floor.
The low-drift regime cannot consume the full topology budget.

label_drift.rationale: Changed labels must be learned above the bounded floor.
Label adaptation must improve untouched drift accuracy by at least four points.
Old-label accuracy cannot fall more than ten points from base holdout.
Unchanged observations and transitions should not materially damage exact planning.

observation_drift.rationale: An already solved observation task uses non-inferiority.
Observation adaptation cannot worsen next-observation prediction.
Original-task reconstruction may degrade by at most ten percent.
Observation drift remains fully observed and uses exact-state planning.
Limited headroom cannot justify the full birth budget.

transition_drift.rationale: Changed transitions require at least one percent relative prediction improvement.
Supported transition accuracy cannot lose more than five points.
Original-task prediction RMSE may rise by at most one observation unit.
Original supported transition accuracy may fall by at most ten points.
Transition drift retains a bounded exact-state planning floor.
Adaptation cannot materially reduce exact planning relative to static.

combined_observation_and_label_drift.rationale: Combined drift requires useful untouched-holdout classification.
Combined drift requires a meaningful absolute adaptation gain.
Observation correction cannot be averaged away by label gain.
Prediction correction cannot be averaged away by classification gain.
Combined behavior permits bounded transition variance but not collapse.
The combined regime remains fully observed and gates exact planning.

partially_observed_ambiguous.rationale: Visible evidence must support useful classification despite hidden-state aliasing.
The aliased regime has adaptation headroom and requires improvement.
Belief-set target success is the capability gate under declared aliasing.
Adaptation must improve alias-aware planning over the static model.
Original visible-state reconstruction cannot materially degrade.
Original visible-state prediction cannot materially degrade.

out_of_domain_value.rationale: Out-of-domain routing cannot certify and uses complete scan.

empty_expert_assignment.rationale: An empty model has no valid assignment.

degenerate_expert_assignment.rationale: A split without two nonempty assignments is rejected.

duplicate_expert.rationale: Duplicate behaviorally identical experts violate topology uniqueness.

tied_distance.rationale: Ties resolve deterministically to the lower expert ID.

routing_lower_bound_equality.rationale: Lower-bound equality cannot certify early return.

maximum_expert_capacity.rationale: The model preserves the declared maximum capacity.

birth_beyond_capacity.rationale: A birth beyond capacity is rejected.

wrong_lifecycle_retirement.rationale: Anchored or wrong-class experts cannot be retired.

poisoned_adaptation_labels.rationale: Poisoned labels produce a retention failure condition.

poisoned_transition_observations.rationale: Poisoned next observations produce a prediction failure condition.

replay_removal_experiment.rationale: A distinct no-replay experiment is worse than protected balanced replay.

catastrophic_forgetting_experiment.rationale: Repeated unprotected updates create a distinct forgetting condition.

balanced_replay_determinism.rationale: Repeated stratified selection is byte-for-byte deterministic.

balanced_replay_no_duplicates.rationale: Replay selection contains no accidental duplicates.

balanced_replay_coverage.rationale: Replay covers every label, action, and state in the fixture.

balanced_replay_sparse_strata.rationale: Sparse strata terminate without invented duplicates.

classification_residual_fixture.rationale: Classification residual changes the normalized birth score.

reconstruction_residual_fixture.rationale: Reconstruction residual changes the normalized birth score.

prediction_residual_fixture.rationale: Prediction residual changes the normalized birth score.

novelty_residual_fixture.rationale: Novelty residual changes the normalized birth score.

inverse_support_residual_fixture.rationale: Inverse support changes the normalized birth score.

uncertainty_residual_fixture.rationale: Uncertainty changes the normalized birth score.

action_coverage_residual_fixture.rationale: Missing action coverage changes the normalized birth score.

retention_risk_residual_fixture.rationale: Anchored retention risk changes the normalized birth score.

unsupported_action_unknown.rationale: An unsupported action remains an unknown graph edge.

top_k_transition_ambiguity.rationale: Two supported transition targets are retained deterministically.

retirement_unique_support_safety.rationale: Retirement that destroys unique support is rejected.

retirement_checkpoint_remap.rationale: Transition target identities are remapped or invalidated after expert compaction and survive canonical roundtrip.

non_finite_serialization.rationale: Non-finite model state cannot be serialized.

raw_metric_mutation.rationale: A changed raw metric changes canonical derived evidence and fails verification.

threshold_mutation.rationale: A changed threshold invalidates the preregistration digest.

executable_trial_result_injection.rationale: An executable-emitted trial result is an unknown raw field.

executable_gate_boolean_injection.rationale: An executable-emitted hard gate is an unknown raw field.

seed_mutation.rationale: Trial seeds must match the frozen derivation.

regime_mutation.rationale: Trial regimes must match the frozen matrix.

aggregate_mutation.rationale: Executable-emitted aggregate or global verdicts are unknown raw fields.

stale_manifest.rationale: A stale source digest cannot equal independent recalculation.

stale_assurance.rationale: Assurance must bind the exact manifest and source digest.

substituted_source.rationale: A substituted maintained source hash fails manifest equality.

reordered_file.rationale: Manifest file order is digest authority.

omitted_file.rationale: An omitted authority fails exact manifest equality.

build_configuration_mutation.rationale: Compiler flags and build identity are manifest authority.

artifact_mutation.rationale: Changed declared bytes fail exact manifest equality.

evidence_file_mutation.rationale: Canonical evidence identity changes when evidence content changes.

nondeterministic_output_detection.rationale: Each trial and self-test is executed twice and must be byte-identical.
